post_publication_install.boundary: Fresh public-index install outside the source checkout with dependency check; not actual assistant-host or independent-user acceptance.

redis.artifact_binding: Rehearsal and publication wheels have the same SHA-256; the exact-wheel disposable-service evidence applies to the published wheel.

Clean-restart persistence using retained mirror and AOF state
limits: Installing the redis extra installs the client, not a Redis service or compatible records
No new writer, generation publisher or automatic cross-agent recall
No Windows Redis service, successful TLS/ACL configuration or abrupt-crash recovery qualification

historical_records.policy: Original records, versioned guides and goal assets preserved; not relabeled as 1.6.0 observations

limits: Software qualification does not establish model quality or consistent fresh, resumed or delegated-agent recall
